# Part VI — Firmware and maintenance

Updating the ECU's firmware, recovering an ECU that will not start, keeping tunes and backups, and changing the studio's pages to suit you.

- **[46 Updating firmware](46-updating-firmware.md)** — When the studio has newer firmware for your ECU, it offers it as you connect — showing what the update changes in your tune — and then flashes it over USB and puts your tune back, converted, without any other tool.
- **[47 Recovering an ECU](47-recovery.md)** — The processor has a USB bootloader built into it that no firmware or tune can damage, so an ECU that will not start can always be given firmware again over the USB cable — and a bad tune is put right by sending a good one.
- **[48 Tunes, layouts and backups](48-files-backups.md)** — The ECU keeps the tune it runs, the studio keeps named copies of it per ECU plus a snapshot at every connect, and a copy of the studio's data folder is a complete backup.
- **[49 Customising the studio](49-customising-studio.md)** — Every page, tab and instrument in the studio is a layout you can change — switch to **Editing**, drag settings and controls onto pages, arrange them, and save the layout for this ECU or to share.
